mapper.sql: id, year, name, owner_user_id, region, school, description, cover_url, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT t.year, ( SELECT t2.cover_url FROM team t2 WHERE t2.year = t.year AND t2.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t2.cover_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t2.cover_url) != '' ORDER BY t2.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS cover_url, COUNT(1) AS published_team_count FROM team t WHERE t.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY t.year ORDER BY CAST(t.year AS UNSIGNED) DESC

SELECT t.id, t.year, t.name, t.region, t.school, t.description, t.cover_url, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, p.id AS page_id FROM team t INNER JOIN team_page p ON p.team_id = t.id WHERE t.year = #{year} AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM team WHERE year = #{year} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT t.id, t.year, t.name, t.region, t.school, t.description, t.cover_url, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, p.id AS page_id FROM team t INNER JOIN team_page p ON p.team_id = t.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team ( year, name, owner_user_id, region, school, description, cover_url, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{year}, #{name}, #{ownerUserId}, #{region}, #{school}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE team SET year = #{year}, name = #{name}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, region = #{region}, school = #{school}, description = #{description}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE team SET status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'ARCHIVED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM team WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status <> 'ARCHIVED' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM team ORDER BY year DESC, id DESC
